name: Ente Auth
hook: Open-source 2FA with end-to-end encrypted backup — on mobile and desktop.
bullets: E2E encrypted cloud backup survives a lost phone
Codes on mobile, desktop, and web kept in sync
No ads, no telemetry, fully open source
setupSteps: Install Ente Auth from F-Droid, the Play Store, or desktop builds
Scan QR codes or import from Authy / Google Authenticator
Turn on encrypted backup so your codes sync safely
details: Ente Auth is a free, open-source authenticator that stores your TOTP secrets encrypted — even Ente can't read them. After Authy killed its desktop app, it fills the gap: native apps for Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux, plus the web, kept in sync through end-to-end encrypted backup. Codes work offline, migration from other 2FA apps is a scan away, and you can self-host the Ente server for full ownership.
